limitations: Retrospective raw observation availability does not prove exchange publication or historical receipt time.
No new returns or rolling values are calculated here; only numeric price positivity/finite observation status and saved forecast finiteness are inspected.
Restored history counts refer to labels actually eligible in at least one registered inference query, not every unscored future tail.
Same calendar timestamps reused under different fold models are not independent observations.
Entire source bytes are hashed; semantic OHLC reads are filtered strictly before 2023-04-16T13:45Z.

rolling_contract.boundary_restoration: reconstructed matured labels; no reuse of fixed calibration/evaluation label masks
rolling_contract.current_support: unchanged original inference and score masks; rolling anchor also limited to inference
rolling_contract.label_availability: canonical OHLC available for tau+1 through tau+24; positive observed entry open tau+1
rolling_contract.latest_possible_scheduled_tau: t - 12 hours; t - 6 hours label is immature
rolling_contract.shared_raw_support: same-fold technical AND perp raw finite on inherited shared feature mask
rolling_contract.source_identity: raw calibration and raw evaluation bind the identical fold/group return model; no cross-fold forecast stitching

scope: Availability, chronology and immutable provenance only; no return values, means, slopes, losses or real rolling forecast/policy computations.

um_data_proof.missing_policy: full grid; NaN raw observations and false observation mask; no interpolation

timestamp_semantics.bar_close_ts: observed inclusive exchange close = bar open + 15 minutes - 1 millisecond
timestamp_semantics.decision_ts: bar open + 15 minutes; clock retained even when observation absent
timestamp_semantics.feature_cutoff: decision_ts strictly before registered cutoff; April raw tail retained only
